JUDGMENT
NON-REPORTABLE
IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
                    CIVIL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 9176-9177 OF 2015
(Arising out of SLP(C)Nos.15427-15428/2013)
     JAIPAL & ORS.
      ... APPELLANT(S)
 
                VS.
     STATE OF U.P. THR.DIST.MAG.& ANR.  ... RESPONDENT(S)
       J U D G M E N T
ANIL R. DAVE, J.
1.
Delay condoned.
2.
Leave granted.
3.
In view of the fact that Civil Appeal No. 3732 of 
2013  and  batch  involving  similar  facts  have  been 
allowed vide order dated 9th December, 2014, we allow 
these appeals and set aside the judgment and order 
passed by the High Court and restore the order passed 
by  the  Reference  Court.   The  appellants  will  be 
entitled to all statutory benefits.  
4.
No costs.
1

Page 2
JUDGMENT
5.
It would be open to the respondents to approach 
this court by way of an appropriate application, if 
they are aggrieved by this order.
      
 .................J.
[ANIL R. DAVE]
..................J.
[ADARSH KUMAR GOEL]
New Delhi;
30th October, 2015.
